issue_title: [Security] Temporary file descriptor (fd) is not closed if os.fdopen raises an exception
fix_summary: Fixed file descriptor leak by wrapping os.fdopen in try/except block to close fd if fdopen fails to take ownership

implementation_notes.problem: When os.fdopen is called with an fd from mkstemp, if fdopen raises an exception during initialization, the fd is leaked because fdopen's context manager never takes ownership.
implementation_notes.solution: Wrap os.fdopen in a try/except block. If fdopen raises OSError, explicitly close the fd before re-raising the exception.
